description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and hosting Orleans silos within various host builder contexts in a .NET application. It provides methods to add Orleans silo configuration to host builders, manage singleton instances, and handle related exceptions.

classes.name: OrleansSiloGenericHostExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring Orleans silos within host builders.

methods.name: UseOrleans
methods.description: Configures the host application builder to host an Orleans silo, with overloads for different builder types.

methods.name: AddOrleans
methods.description: Adds Orleans silo configuration to the service collection, allowing custom configuration via a delegate.

methods.name: AddOrleansCore
methods.description: Internal method to initialize or retrieve an existing ISiloBuilder instance from the service collection.

methods.name: GetOrleansClientAddedException
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating conflicting Orleans client and silo configuration calls.
